test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 16 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Seven friends are sitting in an arch shape facing inwards. R and V are sitting on the corner sides. T says that, “On my right-hand side more than two persons are sitting and R is the last one". Q says that, "On my left-hand side there are three persons sitting in which V is the last one". S and V are sitting beside each other. How many persons are sitting to the left and right side of T respectively?
solution:
According to the information given in question,

1. Number of friends = 7

2. Three persons are sitting on the left-hand side of Q, of which V is the last one.

3. R and V are sitting on the corner sides.

So, this can be represented as-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1957e48fe4f077c118958b4e0bd69545d9e74a38cf379f4f45eab87c67e0ac8a.png] 

Also,

4. S and V are sitting beside each other.

5. More than two persons are sitting on the right-hand side of T, of which R is the last one.

So, the arrangement becomes-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb205a22ddfbc46ccb6019d6744a88718f6b1151b5c07234007e7ab64eb6152a.png] 

Thus, two persons are sitting to the left of T and four persons are sitting to the right of T.

Hence, **'option 4' ** is the correct answer.
